description: Prices travel insurance for a trip under both plans and says whether Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) coverage is available to this traveler, and why not when it isn't. Nothing is saved or charged.

customer_state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the traveler lives in. Only US residents can buy.

destination.description: Where the traveler is going, e.g. "Italy" or "Orlando, FL".

initial_payment_date.description: Date of the traveler's first payment toward the trip, YYYY-MM-DD. Needed before payment for every plan; Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) coverage must be bought within 14 days of it.

trip_cost.description: Total prepaid trip cost in US dollars.
